items.name: Bow
items.note: When a pond fairy returns the normal bow, she uses the tossed-bow receipt 0x3A, which grants the same bow with different graphics and palette.

items.name: BowAndSilverArrows
items.note: The vanilla silver-bow receipt used by the pond fairy upgrade. It grants a bow with Silver Arrow capability even if the player has no bow.

items.name: L1Sword
items.note: The vanilla tossed-Fighter-Sword receipt used when a pond fairy returns the sword unchanged.
detailNote: Randomizers may use this, as it grants only the level 1 sword, avoiding the additional Fighter Shield granted by the Uncle's 0x00 receipt.

items.name: L2Sword
items.note: The vanilla Master Sword, obtained from the Lost Woods pedestal. Receipt 0x01 includes the special sword-pulling animation and cutscene behavior.
detailNote: Randomizers use the alternate receipt 0x50 to grant the same level 2 sword without triggering the vanilla pedestal animation and cutscene behavior.

items.name: HeartContainerFromPieces
items.note: An internal vanilla receipt generated when the player collects a fourth Piece of Heart. It increases maximum health by one heart and refills health.

items.name: BossHeartContainer
items.note: The vanilla boss-drop heart container. It increases maximum health by one heart and supplies one heart of healing.

items.name: SanctuaryHeartContainer
items.note: The vanilla heart container found in the Sanctuary chest. It increases maximum health by one heart and refills health.

nonVanilla.note: Randomizer-defined items and receipts that require a compatible ROM patch. Some grant upgrades available through events in vanilla; others add new behavior.

items.name: SilverArrows
items.note: A randomizer receipt that grants the Silver Arrows upgrade without also granting a bow.

items.name: HalfMagic
items.note: A randomizer receipt for granting the vanilla half-magic upgrade as a shuffled item.
detailNote: Randomizers use the receipt 0x4F to grant quarter magic, which is a vanilla item that is not collectible by normal means.

items.name: ProgressiveSword
items.note: A randomizer variant that upgrades the player's current sword by one level.

items.name: ProgressiveShield
items.note: A randomizer variant that upgrades the player's current shield by one level.

items.name: ProgressiveArmor
items.note: A randomizer variant that upgrades the player's current armor by one level.

items.name: ProgressiveGlove
items.note: A randomizer variant that upgrades the player's current glove by one level.

items.name: BombCapacityUpgrade
items.note: Represents randomizer bomb-capacity upgrades. Vanilla's pond fairy changes capacity directly rather than granting these receipts.
detailNote: 0x51 adds 5 bomb capacity; 0x52 adds 10 bomb capacity.
0x4C grants the combined upgrade to 50-bomb capacity, used when incremental upgrades are combined into one shuffled item.

items.name: ArrowCapacityUpgrade
items.note: Represents randomizer arrow-capacity upgrades. Vanilla's pond fairy changes capacity directly rather than granting these receipts.
detailNote: 0x53 adds 5 arrow capacity; 0x54 adds 10 arrow capacity.
0x4D grants the combined upgrade to 70-arrow capacity, used when incremental upgrades are combined into one shuffled item.

refills.note: These are chest and reward items, not enemy drops or general pickups.

items.name: OneBomb
items.note: Only exists as a Village of Outcasts chest-game prize.

items.name: TenBombs
items.note: A vanilla receipt used when buying a ten-bomb pack from a shop. No vanilla chest or chest-game prize table uses it.

items.name: Heart
items.note: Only exists as a Village of Outcasts chest-game prize.

items.name: SmallMagic
items.note: Has no known vanilla chest or reward location.

currency.note: These are chest and reward items, not enemy drops or general pickups.
